Default.title: Regional context
Default.summary: Proposal language is adapted for {geography} operations and response expectations in {location}.
scopeBullets: Local response assumptions reflect typical operating characteristics in {geography}.
Deployment planning uses standard contact and handoff practices for {region}.
Timeline and escalation assumptions can be fine-tuned during kickoff.
timeline: Regional follow-up for local compliance and permit verification during week 1.
exclusions: Local permitting or municipal compliance requirements are validated during kickoff.

US Northeast.title: Northeast security context
US Northeast.summary: In the Northeast region, service design prioritizes weather resilience, transit adjacency, and dense urban access flow in {location}.
scopeBullets: Prioritize access controls for dense urban or mixed-use environments.
Include transit-adjacent access and pickup/dropoff risk mitigations for {location}.
Schedule escalation checks that account for seasonal weather-related disruption.
timeline: Weather- and transit-aware onboarding checkpoint added in week 2 for Northeast operations.
exclusions: Additional overtime for severe weather response is billed separately.

US Southeast.title: Southeast security context
US Southeast.summary: In the Southeast profile, proposal language and sequencing emphasize heat-related staffing windows and event-driven demand around {location}.
scopeBullets: Plan for high-traffic seasonal periods and community event spikes in {location}.
Document access flow for campus and parking in warm-weather operating conditions.
timeline: Heat and staffing continuity readiness is reviewed in week 1 for Southeast operations.
exclusions: Additional hardening for weather and utility interruption windows is a separate line item.

US Midwest.title: Midwest security context
US Midwest.summary: For Midwest locations, the proposal reflects manufacturing, logistics, and rural-to-urban travel distances around {location}.
scopeBullets: Coordinate patrol loops around facility miles and shift transfer points in {location}.
Include logistics touchpoints when loading or route-sensitive workflows exist.
timeline: Route and logistics coordination checkpoint added in week 2 for Midwest facilities.
exclusions: Extended logistics route support is billed separately if distances increase materially.

US Southwest.title: Southwest security context
US Southwest.summary: For Southwest operations, this proposal adjusts communication and deployment cadence for wide-area coverage around {location}.
scopeBullets: Strengthen site-to-site check timing for wide footprint coverage around {location}.
Address heat and remote access considerations for gate and perimeter controls.
timeline: Coverage continuity planning for high-temperature windows in week 3.
exclusions: Climate adaptation equipment and additional sensors are quoted separately.

US West.title: West region context
US West.summary: West-region proposals prioritize geography-specific commuting, event density, and multi-site response sequencing in {location}.
scopeBullets: Tailor patrol and escalation timing for remote-site spread and traffic windows in {location}.
Include incident communication cadence compatible with multiple time zones and teams.
timeline: Cross-site coordination and communication checks in week 2 for West sites.
exclusions: Dedicated cross-border coordination beyond normal operating areas is a separate scope item.

US International.title: International context
US International.summary: International deployments use globally aware operational language while still mirroring core policy and reporting expectations in {location}.
scopeBullets: Use location-specific escalation owners and authority mapping during onboarding in {location}.
Maintain core service standards while honoring local security and reporting requirements.
timeline: Regional compliance and authority alignment reviewed in week 1 for international operations.
exclusions: Local language, translation, and legal localization support are quoted separately.

Starter.title: Starter Physical Guarding
Starter.summary: Fast deployment package for single teams and standard access coverage.
scopeBullets: 1 security lead per shift with fixed guard posts
Visitor sign-in and escort protocol included
Daily situation log with incident escalation route
Monthly manager summary to security owner
timeline: Week 1: site walk-through and post setup
Week 2: on-site orientation and drills
Week 3: initial performance check and SOP alignment
Week 4: first monthly review
exclusions: Advanced video analytics package not included
Escalation response with third-party resources billed separately
